name: Chrono Lock
source:
A young boy enters a new university. In this environment, he meets a variety of people—friends, rivals, and others, each hiding secrets of their own. But the peace of university life is short-lived, as strange and astonishing events soon engulf him. The boy is inadvertently drawn into other worlds, worlds that seem intertwined and unfathomable.

He doesn’t know if these passages are the result of a real wormhole or some other unknown force.

Are these journeys scientific and explainable, or is there something magical and supernatural behind them?

Amid this chaos, the boy encounters a mysterious figure in one of these worlds—a being who seems to know everything, as if aware of the past, present, and future, holding the entire map of this universe in their hands.

But the question remains:

Is this figure a savior, or part of the same dark game?

Can they help the boy, or will they lead him toward an even darker fate?

Behind all these events, there exists a mechanical and enigmatic entity: a robot of immense power that controls the entire world. No one knows who created it, or what force operates it from behind the scenes.

Rumors suggest that all these events are orchestrated by this unseen hand.

Is this robot—or its mysterious creator—the cause of all the world’s contradictions?

Are they behind every puzzle, every wormhole, every hidden secret?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3979000/]Steam[/url]]
